blocks.orig: Sanctuary Swala is located in an exclusive pocket of the Tarangire National Park. Set on stilts around towering, ancient baobab trees, the elevated dining area, lounge, and library are all sound-tracked by the sing-song of hundreds of birds. The 12 spacious tents themselves boast kingsize beds swathed in neutral linens mingling a fresh design with a new take on safari living. Indoor and outdoor bush-view showers ensure more magical moments of connecting with the surrounding wildlife, especially with the view of the waterhole close by. The elevated main deck is perfect for afternoon sundowners in soft lounge chairs, followed by scrumptious meals from the restaurant and a campfire in a beautiful circular setting under the outstretched night skies. At Sanctuary Swala you experience your safari nights in style!
blocks.html: You will find Sanctuary Swala in an exclusive corner of the Tarangire National Park. Raised on stilts around tall, ancient baobab trees, the dining area, lounge and library are filled with the song of hundreds of birds. The 12 roomy tents have kingsize beds dressed in neutral linens, combining a fresh design with a modern approach to safari living. With indoor and outdoor showers that look out over the bush, you get even more magical moments with the wildlife around you, particularly thanks to the view of the nearby waterhole. The raised main deck is ideal for sundowners in soft lounge chairs in the late afternoon, followed by delicious meals from the restaurant and a campfire in a lovely circular setting beneath the wide night sky. Sanctuary Swala lets you spend your safari nights in style!
